study: Quality-Oriented Engineering Change Dynamics in Apache Projects
finding: Among 2,533 manually classified commits, 40.3% are internal-quality changes, 27.0% external-quality changes, and 32.6% neither. Project-level internal-quality shares range from 0.13 to 0.818, demonstrating strong heterogeneity in change orientation.
source: SmartSHARK commit-intent replication dataset (Trautsch et al.)
